{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk sheath dress, empire waist cut, floor-length length, deep emerald green with hex code #043927, heavy woven silk chiffon.  
Stiletto pumps, pointed toe cut, ankle-high length, burnished gold with hex code #B8860B, patent leather.  
Diamond drop earrings and a matching diamond solitaire necklace, stud cut, short drop length for earrings and medium band length for the necklace, clear white with hex code #FFFFFF, platinum set with simulated diamonds.  
This outfit works because the rich emerald silk captures light elegantly while standing out boldly against typical autumn theatre attire, fulfilling her desire to make a statement. The gold heels add a touch of glamour that complements the evening setting without overwhelming the silhouette. Finally, the sparkling diamond jewelry draws attention to the face and neck, completing a look that feels both sophisticated and uniquely personal for an evening at the opera or theatre."}
